text: Write three headings in the sketchbook: KNOWN, NEEDS CHECKING, CAN WAIT. Under KNOWN, record only what the parent actually said, the symptoms or practical concern mentioned, any appointment already named, and what help has already been offered. Under NEEDS CHECKING, write follow-up questions for tomorrow: What exactly is the current diagnosis or concern? What appointment is scheduled, with whom, and when? Are there instructions, medication changes, or warning signs that need attention tonight? Who else is involved in transport, paperwork, finances, or day-to-day support? What does my parent want me to take responsibility for, and what can remain with someone local? Under CAN WAIT, note future arrangements, paperwork, travel, house logistics, and any decision that requires more information. At the bottom, write immediate steps: send one calm message confirming what I heard, call the relevant office tomorrow if needed, check the calendar, and ask Julian for a second pair of eyes rather than trying to solve the whole situation tonight.
